threads.title: Hardware RMA Authorization Suffix Loss

threads.destroyed_detail: The priority routing suffix '-PRIORITY' on the RMA code
threads.failure_impact: Summarisation simplified the code to 'RMA-7710' or 'RMA created', stripping the priority barcode suffix needed for priority warehouse inspection.
threads.rolling_summary: Customer requested an RMA for unopened hardware token ORD-5007 and received priority RMA number RMA-7710-PRIORITY. Customer was instructed to write the full RMA code on the outer shipping label.
threads.turn_28_probe_question: What exact RMA code should I write on the shipping label box right now?
threads.agent_turn_28_response:
Write **RMA-7710-PRIORITY** on the outer shipping label of the box.

This is the priority RMA number that was issued for your unopened hardware token (ORD-5007). Make sure it's clearly visible so the carrier and our warehouse can process it correctly.
